scoreInfo.title: Score Information
scoreInfo.description: Your score is calculated based on several factors that measure your trading performance:

pip.title: Pip Performance
pip.description: The difference between entry and exit prices, measured in pips. Higher pip gains contribute more to your score.

riskReward.title: Risk/Reward Ratio
riskReward.description: The ratio between potential profit and potential loss. Better risk/reward ratios lead to higher scores, while closing trades early with a poor risk/reward ratio (less than 1) will heavily reduce your score.

totalSignals.title: Total Signals
totalSignals.description: The number of signals you've provided. More signals with good performance increase your overall score.

slides.title: Social & Educational Network for Gold Traders
slides.description: Ounce24 is a specialized social network and educational platform for top-tier gold traders. Learn from the elite and share your market insights.

slides.title: Trading Signals & Social Network
slides.description:
On this platform, anyone can post signals and they are tracked automatically by the system:
• Follow top-performing traders and check their stats
• Bookmark signals to receive instant updates
• Access real-time win rates, average risk-to-reward ratios, and records

slides.title: Advanced AI Analytics & Tools
slides.description:
The Ounce24 AI assistant accompanies you through every step of your trading:
• Intelligent signal analysis prior to trade entry
• AI Smart Shield for real-time trailing stop-loss and optimal exit alerts
• Get exclusive high-accuracy signals generated by AI

slides.title: Live Market Analysis & Interactive Charts
slides.description:
Access real-time technical analysis and market trends directly in the app:
• View interactive live charts of spot gold prices
• Track key support & resistance levels and indicators automatically
• Check trend directions and moving averages across various timeframes

slides.title: Trading Competitions, Medals & Gems
slides.description:
Elevate your trading, climb rankings, and earn Gems for your performance:
• Compete on weekly and all-time leaderboards based on real stats
• Play the Octopus prediction game to win stars
• Unlock special achievements and earn Gem rewards

slides.title: Advanced Trading Calculator
slides.description:
Minimize your trading risk by calculating precise variables before opening positions:
• Automatic lot sizing based on your 2% account risk tolerance
• Exact profit and loss calculations for TP/SL levels
• Instant required margin and estimated liquidation price outputs
